entries.title: What's New in MindPal 5.0
entries.summary: MindPal 5.0 introduces real-time voice dictation with live audio reactivity, clinical-grade Pro model reasoning, and an exclusive preview of MindPal Presence spatial vision.
highlights: Real-Time Voice Dictation — Fluid speech transcription with live waveform visualizer and streaming word opacity
Pro Clinical Tier — 2× compute budget for in-depth diagnostic inquiry, memory synthesis, and emotional nuance
MindPal Presence Preview — On-device spatial vision for Solo reflection, Couples mediation, and Group circles
Refined Clinical Design — Borderless starter chips with vibrant mood colors, compact squircle controls, and elevated layout
